claims.claim: NYSE IR / CIK 0001699150 identity is validated; Q2 issuer/SEC evidence, 2026 proxy and independent valuation are current, and a materially different 2025 10-K source path now establishes supplier concentration facts.

2025 10-K disclosure states primary raw materials include cast iron, aluminum and steel, with copper exposure through motors; only a few key-component suppliers have long-term contracts and certain iron castings, motors and engineered components remain single-source.

factors.name: supplyChainResilience
factors.basis: Broad raw-material availability is offset by explicit single-source engineered components and limited long-term supplier contracting.

risks.risk: Single-source castings, motors and engineered components can disrupt customer commitments.
